text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. With the dawn of the new year,
Mejiro Bright has entered the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter-clatter~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~,
thank you so very much for all your help this past year~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to working with you this year as well~.
Most humbly~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I gave a rather nonsensical reply,
but since the conversation flowed anyway, I'll take it.
choice_data_list: By the way, Bright, what's your resolution for this year?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Resolutions~. Of course I have already decided on them~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—To run well in the Classic Triple Crown,
and bring glory to the Mejiro family—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though Mejiro Bright was normally laid-back, she answered without hesitation here. Her goal was crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Especially~ the "Satsuki Sho" and the "Japanese Derby," which no Mejiro has ever won yet, are the ones I really want to do my best in~.
choice_data_list: I see. The Mejiro family is still...
I see, the Mejiro family still hasn't...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that makes me reflect once more. As of yet, no Umamusume in the Mejiro family
has ever won both the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If her sights are set on that... she might have already scouted out her rival Umamusume as well.
choice_data_list: The Satsuki Sho—I can't afford to lose to my rivals!
The Satsuki Sho—we can't lose to our rivals!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Howaa~... Rivals...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. What kind of person
is your rival~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...She didn't seem fully aware of the situation around her. Indeed, the Umamusume of Mejiro Bright's generation...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Bright...
You're aiming for the Satsuki Sho, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't found my own running style.
If only I could figure it out in time for the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Silence Suzuka. A quiet Umamusume
who preferred solitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That wavering heart affected her running, leaving her results lacking. Her standing on the Classic Road was also a step down from the main contenders."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm, I see it! I see it, Bright-san!
You intend to race straight down the Classic path, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"A formidable rival is sure to appear!
Well, that rival is me, though.
Even if it's just me wishing I could be!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Matikanefukukitaru.
An Umamusume whose hobbies are fortune-telling and the occult.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seems to be trying hard, but the common rumor
is that she's relying on sheer luck for now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Suzuka and Lady Fukukitaru~. The two of them
would chat every now and then, but~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we were peers, weren't we~?
Come to think of it now~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The easygoing Mejiro Bright seemed to think of them merely as conversation partners. But her two rivals, naturally...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't even aware of it myself.
I've had my hands full just polishing my running.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Me too! I was completely focused on boosting my luck!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nobody is keeping an eye on anyone else...
Everyone is right in the middle of finding themselves,
without any room to worry about rivals yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. Since it's the New Year and all,
I was hoping we could deepen our bond with those two~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Who should I hang out with, and what should we do~?
Then again, maybe spending it all alone would be nice too~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spending New Year's with my classmates.
Now then, what should we do?
choice_data_list: Braiding each other's hair with Suzuka

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My, hair braiding~.
Lady Suzuka, would you permit me
to braid your beautiful hair~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have simply adored knitting
ever since I was a little girl~

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Braiding hair together...? I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's go~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Swi~sh swoo~sh, swi~sh swoo~sh♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Bright?
It's been quite a while, are you done knitting?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: No, no~ I've only combed it out so far~. The braiding starts now~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like this will take quite a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright took her sweet time fixing Silence Suzuka's appearance.
While they played around, she built up quite a lot of patience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Bonsai all by myself... Well, yes~.
I can play with my schoolmates anytime, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell to you both~.
I shall indulge in a little viewing~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Tonk... tonk...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright simply gazed at the bonsai.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~.
I have come to a realization~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: They say bonsai is a 'universe in miniature,' but~ looking closely at it like this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So it was a tree after all, not the cosmos, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I was at a loss for words. Even amidst it all,
Mejiro Bright was steadily being soothed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Playing with dolls~. Ah, that is right, Fukukitaru-sama.
Are you interested in this child~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"This is 'Maki-chan'~
She's such a veeery good girl~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, to think you have such a thing!
You truly are very devout, Bright-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You mean that, right? The thing that
takes all of one's impurities upon itself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, a 'katashiro' is...
a doll that has been used in purification rituals since ancient times, and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It means it will take on any misfortune
that might befall you, Bright-san.
How blessed~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ Poor Maki-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Receiving Shinto teachings in front of the shrine,
Mejiro Bright gained some trivia knowledge.
